notes.title: Tragedy at Ashville Lane RELEASE!
notes.content:
Once again I want to give the biggest thanks to anyone and everyone who decided to play my game and give me a chance. I plan on making bigger and bigger games with a lot more to come. I am currently working on another horror game this time with a larger scale and subsequently will probably take a bit more time to create.

Thank you once again for purchasing and playing the game! I very much appreciate it and will look to exceed expectations on the next title.

- Simeon Zahariev (acid)
